programs.title: The Zoo

programs.title: Crikey! It's Shark Week
programs.desc: Robert Irwin comes face to face with a great white shark for the first time with shark conservationists Paul de Gelder and Madison Stewart  following in his father's footsteps, he will get as close as possible to these incredible creatures.

programs.title: The Zoo
programs.desc: Beloved camel Max develops a large abscess on the top of his head  a marmot prepares for her first classroom visit as an ambassador animal  a peregrine falcon found at the base of a skyscraper is brought to the zoo for a health check.

programs.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet: Old Dog, New Hope
programs.desc: Dr. Jeff and his team lend a hand at National Mill Dog Rescue and are eager to find Ginger the Pomeranian a forever home  a dog that loves to swallow household objects must undergo emergency surgery  Jimmy the gecko gives Dr. Baier a surprise.

programs.title: I Was Prey: Blood in the Water
programs.desc: A grizzly bear charges taxidermist Wilf Lloyd while he hunts elk with his son-in-law in the Canadian Rocky Mountains  miles from shore, diving 180 feet below the surface, spearfisher Anthony Segrich finds a bull shark charging toward him.

programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Robert's Python Swim
programs.desc: Robert gets in the water with Gloria, a 12-foot reticulated python, to swim alongside her for the first time in the Crocoseum  Bindi welcomes home two orphaned kangaroo joeys  Terri helps release a rescued wedge-tailed eagle back into the wild.
